infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Cairn needs your location to track your track and show nearby markers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Cairn needs background location to keep recording your track when the screen is locked or you switch apps.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cairn uses the camera to anchor flags in the AR view, letting you place markers at real-world spots and see them again on future hikes.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Cairn reads device orientation to point the in-app compass to true north and to anchor AR flags as you turn.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cairn needs photo library access so you can attach photos to your routes and cairns.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Cairn saves the photos you capture in the app to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cairn uses the microphone for voice notes attached to flags (optional).
